title: Inbox discovery is idempotent and history-aware
summary: AlchemyGitInbox owns the question 'what is pending?'. It finds compatible main-inbox and submission-branch ready markers, ignores ready markers inherited from accepted main, suppresses already-receipted submissions, deduplicates identical same-id package trees, and turns conflicting same-id trees into an explicit conflict candidate.
invariants: The resident service must consume inbox candidates; it must not reimplement Git history scanning.
A branch ready marker counts only when added after the branch's merge-base with accepted main.
Identical same-id package trees may deduplicate; different package trees under one submission id are a conflict.

provenance.claim: Pending scan over accepted main and remote branches.
